name: Lunaria
description: Honesty seed pods: translucent oval discs on short stalks, overlapping on the sheet, each showing the three dark seeds inside it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-10, 10)%, @r(-10, 10)%) rotate(@r(-30, 30)deg) scale(@r(0.8, 1.05)); transform: translate(@r(-10, 10)%, @r(-10, 10)%) rotate(@r(-30, 30)deg) scale(@r(0.8, 1.05)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; right: 8%; top: 2%; bottom: 10%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: @r(0.55, 0.85); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(6% 8% at 47% 26%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 8% at 53% 45%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 8% at 47% 64%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 48.5%, #000 48.5% 51.5%, transparent 51.5%) 0 100% / 100% 12% no-repeat; mask: radial-gradient(6% 8% at 47% 26%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 8% at 53% 45%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 8% at 47% 64%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 48.5%, #000 48.5% 51.5%, transparent 51.5%) 0 100% / 100% 12% no-repeat; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
